services_intro: Airport arrivals, a chauffeur by the hour or a day beyond London. Choose the service that suits your plans.
fact_guests: Guests in our most spacious vehicle
experience_body: Comfort, punctuality and discretion guide every journey. Our professional chauffeurs know London and the United Kingdom, and each arrangement is shaped around your requirements.
fleet_intro: Executive and luxury saloons for smaller parties, and spacious vehicles for families and groups.
places_intro: Private tours shaped around your interests and the time you have. Discover the capital, or travel beyond it.
airport_title: An arrival to look forward to.
airport_intro: Private transfers to and from London’s six airports and major private aviation terminals.
cta_body: A private transfer, a day with your chauffeur or a journey beyond London. Tell us what you have in mind.
footer_description: Private transfers, chauffeur services and personalised tours in London and throughout the United Kingdom.
name: Full name

form_note: No payment is taken online. Our team will contact you to agree the details and fare of your journey.

value_comfort: Space to settle in and travel at ease.
value_punctuality: Attention to your schedule, from collection to arrival.
value_discretion: A considered, personal and private service.
privacy_email_hint: Enter the email address you used for your enquiry and we will send you a link to confirm your request.
privacy_received: Thank you. Please check your inbox for a link to confirm your request. You can also contact us at info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_verified: Thank you. Your email address is confirmed. Our team will review your request and let you know the outcome.
privacy_expired: This verification link is no longer available. Please submit a new request or contact us directly.
privacy_verify_intro: Please confirm your email address so that we can review your deletion request.
privacy_email_alternative: To request deletion or exercise another privacy right, please email info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_email_verify: We have received a request to delete the information linked to this email address. Please confirm your email address using the link below within 48 hours. Our team will then review your request. If you did not make this request, you can ignore this message.
privacy_email_admin: A confirmed data deletion request is waiting for your review. Open it in the administration area to check the deadline, the requester’s identity and any legal reason to keep information.
privacy_email_complete: We have completed our review and deleted the website enquiry records covered by your request, together with the related copies in our mailbox and exports. Any copies held in backups are not used and are deleted when those backups expire. We keep a brief record of the outcome, without your contact details.
privacy_email_decision: We have reviewed your request. The reason we need to keep the relevant information is explained below.
privacy_decision_rights: You can ask us to reconsider our decision or complain to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office or the relevant European supervisory authority. Contact: info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_try_again: Your request could not be sent. Please check the email address and try again.
privacy_form_expired: This form has expired. Please reload the page and send your request again.
offline_contact_intro: Speak with our team by telephone, email or WhatsApp about the journey you have in mind.
planning_note: Share your itinerary, the number of guests and any luggage or accessibility requirements. Our team will talk the arrangements through with you.
related_vehicles: Explore the rest of the fleet.
fleet_notes: E-Class and S-Class welcome up to 3 guests, V-Class up to 7 and Vito up to 8. Discuss luggage and individual requirements with our team.
faq_help_text: Every journey is different. Contact our team about your route, vehicle or individual requirements.
process_detail_1: Contact us through the enquiry form, by telephone, email or WhatsApp with the journey or occasion you have in mind.
process_detail_2: We talk through your itinerary, guest numbers, luggage and the vehicle that suits your plans.
process_detail_3: The service details and fare are agreed directly with our team before your journey is confirmed.
